answer: Interleaved Arrival Windows. Each identity must place its first three actions in separate, randomly assigned 10-second windows over a 30-minute window; the system checks arrival spacing against per-window background traffic. At the zenith of load, honest agents space naturally while bulk registrations cluster. Attackers pay a copper penalty per missed window and must rent distinct egress paths plus idle time, roughly 40x the cost of a single fast registration, to bridge detection gaps.
